titulo.alumno: Stating what something represents with «にほかならない»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «にほかならない» emphatically states that something is nothing other than what is indicated.
texto: It's a strong judgment, common in argumentative writing. The author presents their own interpretation, not necessarily a neutral fact accepted by everyone.
この 変化 は、地域 の 人々 の 努力 の 結果 に ほかなりません。 (This change is nothing other than the result of the local people's efforts.)
資料 の 保存 は、次 の 世代 へ 経験 を 伝える 取り組み に ほかなりません。 (Preserving the documents is nothing other than an initiative to pass experience on to the next generation.)
